description: `tasks --reclaimable` prints `open backlog:` after the --reclaimable write-leg report (`would close`/`stale bookkeeping`), not before it, and each candidate/stale line names `agent={!r}` ahead of `pane={!r}` — single-quoted like Python's repr, never `{:?}`'s always-double-quoted Debug form, and never missing the `agent=` field entirely. Found via `conformance/diff_fuzz.py` seed 50015 among others.
